# Resend — Style Reference

> Matte black glass under one raking light, code etched in pewter. Domaine and Favorit at weight 400 sit on a #000000 void, traced by 19%-alpha white hairlines, with color rationed to status badges and a single syntax yellow.

**Theme:** dark

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Resend speaks a terminal-noir developer language: a pure #000000 canvas (19 background uses) with no gray mid-surfaces, only a 4%-alpha frosted fill (#d8f4f609) and an inverted #ffffff reserved for tiny details. The chromatic budget is three hues, and all three are confined. Mint #46fea5d4 and amber #ffca16 appear only inside status badges, and pale yellow #ffff92 appears only inside code strings. No action, heading or surface carries color. Typography runs on weight 400 everywhere that matters. Favorit headlines sit at 56px with -2.8px tracking, Domaine appears once at 96px, and Commit Mono 12px is the most-used text style on the page (433 instances), so code outnumbers prose. Hierarchy comes from size and a four-step gray ladder (#f0f0f0 to #464a4d), not from weight. Shapes are soft-rounded at 16px for buttons and 24px for cards, and elevation is a 1px #d6ebfd30 hairline rather than shadow. The page reads as a lit object in a dark studio rather than a dashboard.

## Tokens — Colors

| Name | Value | Token | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| Jet Canvas | `#000000` | `--color-jet-canvas` | Page background, section fills, and the 8px knockout ring behind timeline nodes (19 background uses). It is true black rather than near-black, so every translucent hairline reads at full contrast. |
| Frosted Glass | `#d8f4f609` | `--color-frosted-glass` | Fill for the glass CTA, bento cards and code-window chrome at 4% alpha. It cools the black toward blue without introducing a visible second gray. |
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper-white` | Primary CTA labels and the few inverted fills (29 text uses, 4 background uses). It is the brightest pixel on the page. Do not use it as a large surface. |
| Graphite Gutter | `#464a4d` | `--color-graphite-gutter` | Code line numbers, receding meta and inactive syntax (105 uses). It is the dimmest legible ink and pushes scaffolding behind content. |
| Iron Caption | `#6c6c6c` | `--color-iron-caption` | Code tag names, muted keywords and comments (66 uses). It is the mid-tone of the syntax palette that separates structure from values. |
| Pewter Code | `#a0a0a0` | `--color-pewter-code` | Default Commit Mono ink for brackets, punctuation and plain tokens (219 uses, the most-used text color). Its rank shows that code is the majority text. |
| Ash Body | `#a1a4a5` | `--color-ash-body` | Paragraphs, nav items, secondary buttons and SDK labels (125 uses). It is the prose twin of Pewter Code with a faint cool cast that marks it as reading copy. |
| Fog Ink | `#f0f0f0` | `--color-fog-ink` | H1, H2, the logo and footer links (60 uses). It is off-white so that 96px serif glyphs do not glare against #000000. |
| Mist Title | `#fcfdffef` | `--color-mist-title` | Favorit 20px card titles and emphasized in-card labels (32 uses). At 94% alpha it sits one step brighter than Fog Ink inside framed content. |
| Frosted Border | `#d6ebfd30` | `--color-frosted-border` | The system hairline on card outlines, code windows, button edges and tile frames (69 border uses plus 3 fills). At 19% cool white, it is the entire elevation model. |
| Sunbeam String | `#ffff92` | `--color-sunbeam-string` | Code string literals and the active SDK tile outline (7 uses). It is the only warm note in structural content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color. |
| Mint Signal | `#46fea5d4` | `--color-mint-signal` | "Delivered" badge text and success states, laid over a 12% tint of itself. It is status punctuation only. Do not use it for links or buttons. |
| Amber Signal | `#ffca16` | `--color-amber-signal` | "Complained" badge text and warning timeline icons, over a 12% tint of itself. It marks warnings rather than decorating, and it is rationed to event data. |

## Tokens — Typography

### ABC Favorit — the headline grotesk, set at weight 400 with tight tracking and stylistic sets · `--font-abc-favorit`
- **Substitute:** Geist at 400, Inter Tight at 400, Space Grotesk at 400 (tracked to -0.05em). Favorit draws true to its nominal weight, slightly sturdier than Inter 400, so do not drop to 300.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 14px, 16px, 20px, 56px
- **Line height:** 1.0, 1.2, 1.3, 1.43, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** -2.8px at 56px (-0.05em), -0.8px at 16px (-0.05em), 0px at 20px, 0.35px at 14px (0.025em, weight 500)
- **OpenType features:** `"ss01", "ss03", "ss04", "ss05", "ss11"`
- **Role:** Favorit carries every H2 and H3 at weight 400, which deliberately declines the convention of 600–700 section headings. The -0.05em tracking at 56px compresses each line into a dense slab, so scale does the shouting. The scale jumps straight from 20px to 56px, a 2.8 ratio that skips the Major Third (1.25) ladder most marketing sites climb. The page therefore has headlines and labels with no middle tier. The single hero exception is Domaine, a high-contrast serif at 96px/1.0 with -0.96px tracking that shares Favorit's stylistic sets (substitute Newsreader at 400 or Instrument Serif at 400).

### Inter — the UI and reading workhorse at untouched tracking · `--font-inter`
- **Substitute:** Inter at 400, Geist at 400, IBM Plex Sans at 400. Inter Website renders at its nominal weight, so match numbers directly.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px, 24px
- **Line height:** 1.33, 1.43, 1.5, 1.6
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at all sizes
- **Role:** Inter handles everything functional: 18px/1.5 lead paragraphs in #a1a4a5, 14px nav items at 500, and CTAs at 600. It is the only family that rises to 600, so semibold is reserved for buttons and works as an action signal rather than a heading device. Zero tracking keeps it neutral beside Favorit's compressed headlines.

### Commit Mono — the majority voice for code, IDs and logs · `--font-commit-mono`
- **Substitute:** Commit Mono at 400 (open source), Geist Mono at 400, JetBrains Mono at 350. JetBrains draws heavier at 400, so step it down.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px
- **Line height:** 1.33, 1.43, 1.5
- **Letter spacing:** 0px at all sizes
- **Role:** With 559 instances, Commit Mono outnumbers Inter roughly two to one, an anti-convention ratio for a marketing page. The product is an API, so syntax is the illustration. A single weight across three sizes keeps code flat and documentary, with color doing the tokenizing.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Commit Mono | 400 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 500 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| heading-sm | ABC Favorit | 400 | 20px | 1.3 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | ABC Favorit | 400 | 56px | 1.2 | -2.8px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Domaine | 400 | 96px | 1.0 | -0.96px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Set the canvas to #000000 and draw every container edge as a 1px #d6ebfd30 hairline — the pure void is what lets 19% white read as structure.
- Set every headline at weight 400, with Favorit at 56px and -2.8px tracking — size and compression carry hierarchy, so weight stays free for 600 action labels.
- Fill feature space with real code in Commit Mono 12px/16px or 14px/20px — monospace is the majority voice (559 instances) and doubles as the illustration.
- Reserve Domaine 96px/1.0 for the one hero headline — a single serif moment reads as a signature, while two would read as indecision.
- Step radii down as you nest: 24px card, 16px button or image, 10px tile, 6px badge, 4px chip — each layer reads as contained by the one around it.
- Spend color only on status: #46fea5d4 and #ffca16 at Inter 12px weight 500 over 12% tints of themselves — state is the only information that earns hue.
- Express hierarchy through the gray ladder #f0f0f0 / #a1a4a5 / #6c6c6c / #464a4d — four lightness steps replace color and weight as the ranking device.

### Don't
- Don't soften #000000 into a conventional #111111 charcoal canvas — lifted blacks lower hairline contrast and the 4%-alpha #d8f4f609 fill disappears into the ground.
- Don't replace the code windows with marketing illustrations or icon grids — code-as-content on a black void is the identity, and without it the page reads as generic SaaS rather than an email API.
- Don't adopt #00a3ff (a single-use decorative value, not a system token) as the primary button fill, even though automated extractors label it primary — the CTA is glass with #ffffff text, and a blue fill would be the loudest object on the page.
- Don't bold Favorit headings to 600 or 700 — weight 400 at 56px is the signature, and heavy weight converts quiet authority into conventional shouting.
- Don't add soft drop shadows such as 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) to cards — shadows are invisible on #000000 and muddy the edge. The 1px hairline is non-negotiable.
- Don't round the primary CTA to a 9999px pill — the 16px radius belongs to actions, and full pills are reserved for the announcement badge, avatars and logo frames.
- Don't apply negative tracking to Inter or Commit Mono — they run at 0px. Never extend Favorit's -0.05em compression to body copy, where it collapses legibility at 14px.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #000000 (Jet Canvas)
- card fill: #d8f4f609 (Frosted Glass)
- hairline: #d6ebfd30 (Frosted Border)
- heading text: #f0f0f0 (Fog Ink)
- body text: #a1a4a5 (Ash Body)
- code text: #a0a0a0 (Pewter Code)
- primary action: no distinct CTA color

**Color in Data**
Charts and logs stay neutral, with #a1a4a5 bars on #000000 and #d6ebfd30 gridlines. Only state-bearing series may take #46fea5d4 or #ffca16, drawn as 12% tint fills with full-strength strokes, so data never outshouts the 56px headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor 40px tall with 0 16px padding, border-radius 16px, background #d8f4f609, backdrop-filter blur(25px), 2px solid #d6ebfd30 border, label "Get started" in Inter 14px weight 600 line-height 1.43 color #ffffff with 0px letter-spacing, and box-shadow 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). Pair it with a ghost button of identical size and radius, transparent background, 1px transparent border, label "Log in" in Inter 14px weight 600 color #a1a4a5, with a 16px gap between them.

2. Build a hero section on #000000 inside a 1280px container with 96px top padding. On the left, in a 480px column, place a pill badge (9999px radius, 1px #d6ebfd30 border, #d8f4f609 fill, 4px 8px padding, Inter 12px weight 400 #f0f0f0) and then, after 24px, an H1 in Domaine (fallback Newsreader) weight 400 at 96px, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -0.96px, color #f0f0f0, with 12px bottom padding. Follow it with a paragraph in Inter 18px weight 400 line-height 1.5 color #a1a4a5, and then, after 32px, the primary and ghost button pair. On the right, place a 3D render of a matte-black cube. Behind everything, run a soft diagonal light streak image at full viewport width.

3. Build a bento feature card: background #d8f4f609, 1px solid #d6ebfd30 border, border-radius 24px, padding 24px. At the top, add a decorative radial highlight at the upper edge. Inside, place a live mockup: a 6px-radius badge reading "Delivered" in Inter 12px weight 500, capitalize, color #46fea5d4, on a 12% tint of the same green with 2px 6px padding. Below it, three log lines in Commit Mono 14px line-height 1.43, with "HTTP 200:" in #a0a0a0 and the ID strings in #6c6c6c. Finish with a title in ABC Favorit (fallback Geist) 20px weight 400 line-height 1.3 color #fcfdffef and a description in Inter 14px weight 400 color #a1a4a5, separated by 8px.

4. Build a navigation bar: position sticky, top 0, height 58px, transparent background over #000000, contents centered in a 1280px container. On the left, an 80px-wide wordmark in #f0f0f0. In the center, a row of items (Features, Company, Enterprise, Help, Docs, AI with 12px chevrons, plus Pricing) in Inter 14px weight 500 color #a1a4a5 with 4px 12px padding. On the right, a ghost "Log in" button and a glass "Get started" button, each 40px tall with 16px radius and 0 16px padding, 8px apart. Add no border or shadow to the bar.

**Role:** Opening statement with 3D object.

A two-column hero. The left column is 480px wide and holds Domaine 96px/1.0 at weight 400, -0.96px tracking, #f0f0f0, and 12px bottom padding. Below it sit an Inter 18px/1.5 #a1a4a5 lead of two lines and a 16px-gap button pair. The right column holds a matte-black 3D cube render, with a diagonal light streak crossing the full 1910px width. It is the only serif moment on the page.

### Logo Wall
**Role:** Customer trust row.

A monochrome grid. It has six columns by two rows of white customer marks at roughly 24px cap height, centered under an Inter 14px/1.6 #a1a4a5 caption, with a 48px row gap and an "Explore Enterprise" text link in Inter 14px at weight 500. It has no cards, borders or color, so the logos read as one quiet texture rather than a sponsor banner.

### SDK Language Tiles
**Role:** Language selector for code sample.

A row of 13 square icon tiles. Each is 40px square with a #d8f4f609 fill, a 1px #d6ebfd30 border and 10px radius, carrying a line icon in #a1a4a5. The button computes at Inter 16px at weight 400, with the visible label set at 12px below each tile. The active tile switches its border to Sunbeam String #ffff92, the one place yellow leaves the code. The tiles tab through Node.js, Python, Go and the other SDKs.

### Code Window Card
**Role:** Live code sample as illustration.

The signature content surface. It uses a #000000 body, a 1px #d6ebfd30 border, 16px radius and 32px padding. Code is set in Commit Mono 14px/20px at weight 400 in #a0a0a0, with line numbers in #464a4d, keywords in #6c6c6c and strings in #ffff92. The footer holds "View on GitHub" and "Download ZIP" links in Inter 12px with 20px 16px 12px padding. The window replaces the conventional feature illustration with working code.

### Bento Feature Card
**Role:** Main content card for features.

A framed dark panel. It has a Frosted Glass #d8f4f609 fill, a 1px #d6ebfd30 border, 24px radius and 24px padding, with a decorative top-edge spotlight gradient that is not a system token. The title is Favorit 20px/1.3 at weight 400 in #fcfdffef, and the description is Inter 14px #a1a4a5. Each card hosts a live UI mockup (send bar, log lines, event timeline), so the card frames product rather than icons and copy.

### Status Badge — Delivered / Complained
**Role:** Email event state marker.

A small tinted label. It uses a 6px radius and 2px 6px padding, set in Inter 12px at weight 500 with capitalize. Delivered is #46fea5d4 text on a 12% tint of Mint Signal, and Complained is #ffca16 text on a 12% tint of Amber Signal. It has no border. This is where the chromatic budget is spent, and it is spent only on state.

### Inline Data Chip
**Role:** Recipient, agent and feedback tokens.

A hairline-outlined token. It has a transparent fill, a 1px #d6ebfd30 border, 4px radius and 2px 6px padding, set in Inter 12px at weight 400 in #f0f0f0, and it sometimes carries a 12px brand glyph (Gmail, macOS). Its 4px radius is the tightest in the system, which marks it as data inside a sentence rather than an interactive control.

### Event Timeline Node
**Role:** Webhook event sequence display.

A vertical log rail. A 1px #d6ebfd30 connector line links 24px square icon nodes with 6px radius and #ffca16 glyphs. Each node carries the subtle-2 shadow (0 0 0 8px #000000) to knock the rail out behind it. A Commit Mono 12px timestamp in #a1a4a5 follows each node. The black ring is an anti-convention use of box-shadow as negative space rather than elevation.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Set the canvas to #000000 and draw every container edge as a 1px #d6ebfd30 hairline — the pure void is what lets 19% white read as structure.
- Set every headline at weight 400, with Favorit at 56px and -2.8px tracking — size and compression carry hierarchy, so weight stays free for 600 action labels.
- Fill feature space with real code in Commit Mono 12px/16px or 14px/20px — monospace is the majority voice (559 instances) and doubles as the illustration.
- Reserve Domaine 96px/1.0 for the one hero headline — a single serif moment reads as a signature, while two would read as indecision.
- Step radii down as you nest: 24px card, 16px button or image, 10px tile, 6px badge, 4px chip — each layer reads as contained by the one around it.
- Spend color only on status: #46fea5d4 and #ffca16 at Inter 12px weight 500 over 12% tints of themselves — state is the only information that earns hue.
- Express hierarchy through the gray ladder #f0f0f0 / #a1a4a5 / #6c6c6c / #464a4d — four lightness steps replace color and weight as the ranking device.

### Don't
- Don't soften #000000 into a conventional #111111 charcoal canvas — lifted blacks lower hairline contrast and the 4%-alpha #d8f4f609 fill disappears into the ground.
- Don't replace the code windows with marketing illustrations or icon grids — code-as-content on a black void is the identity, and without it the page reads as generic SaaS rather than an email API.
- Don't adopt #00a3ff (a single-use decorative value, not a system token) as the primary button fill, even though automated extractors label it primary — the CTA is glass with #ffffff text, and a blue fill would be the loudest object on the page.
- Don't bold Favorit headings to 600 or 700 — weight 400 at 56px is the signature, and heavy weight converts quiet authority into conventional shouting.
- Don't add soft drop shadows such as 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.4) to cards — shadows are invisible on #000000 and muddy the edge. The 1px hairline is non-negotiable.
- Don't round the primary CTA to a 9999px pill — the 16px radius belongs to actions, and full pills are reserved for the announcement badge, avatars and logo frames.
- Don't apply negative tracking to Inter or Commit Mono — they run at 0px. Never extend Favorit's -0.05em compression to body copy, where it collapses legibility at 14px.

## Surfaces

| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Jet Canvas | `#000000` | Page ground, code-window body, timeline knockout ring |
| 1 | Frosted Glass | `#d8f4f609` | Bento cards, CTA fill, SDK tiles, announcement pill |
| 2 | Frosted Border | `#d6ebfd30` | Tinted fill for hovered or active tiles and toggles (3 fill uses) |
| 3 | Paper White | `#ffffff` | Inverted micro-fills such as toggle knobs and active indicators |

## Elevation

- **Logo frames and avatar rings:** `0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 25, 28, 0.88)`
- **Timeline nodes (knockout over connector line):** `0 0 0 8px #000000`
- **Glass CTA buttons:** `0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`

The shadows that exist are structural rather than atmospheric. Two of the three are 0-blur spread rings, and the CTA shadow is effectively invisible on black. Perceived depth comes from the 1px #d6ebfd30 hairline and the 25px backdrop blur instead of cast light.

## Imagery

Imagery splits into two registers. The first is rendered 3D objects: a matte-black Rubik-style cube in the hero and a dark envelope icon in a 96px rounded tile, both lit with chrome highlights from one raking light. A full-bleed 1910 × 993px light-streak image sweeps diagonally behind the hero. The second register is product UI rebuilt in HTML: send bars, HTTP 200 logs and webhook timelines framed in 24px-radius cards with 1px #d6ebfd30 borders and no shadow. Embedded email previews use Helvetica at 14px and 24px, which is mockup-internal and not a system font. Icons are thin line glyphs in #a1a4a5. Spotlight gradients on card top edges and the gold gradient on "this morning" are decorative, not system tokens. Customer logos are flat white. The narrative is a dark studio where the product itself is the lit subject.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1280px container, with prose capped at 480–1024px. Sections are separated by 96px, stretching to 144px around the logo wall. The hero is a two-column split, with a left-aligned 480px Domaine headline block opposite a centered 3D cube. Sections alternate between centered compositions (logo wall, "Integrate this morning" with its SDK row and code window) and left-aligned compositions (the "First-class developer experience" headline over a two-column bento). The logo wall uses six columns by two rows, the SDK selector is a single row of 13 tiles, and feature cards pair in two columns. The navigation is sticky, transparent and 58px tall, with the wordmark left, menus centered, and Log in plus Get started right. The footer continues on #000000 with Inter 14px #a1a4a5 link columns. At 375px, drop the display to 56px, stack all grids to one column, and tighten section gaps to 64px. Overall density: spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #000000 (Jet Canvas)
- card fill: #d8f4f609 (Frosted Glass)
- hairline: #d6ebfd30 (Frosted Border)
- heading text: #f0f0f0 (Fog Ink)
- body text: #a1a4a5 (Ash Body)
- code text: #a0a0a0 (Pewter Code)
- primary action: no distinct CTA color

**Color in Data**
Charts and logs stay neutral, with #a1a4a5 bars on #000000 and #d6ebfd30 gridlines. Only state-bearing series may take #46fea5d4 or #ffca16, drawn as 12% tint fills with full-strength strokes, so data never outshouts the 56px headline.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Build a Primary Action Button: an anchor 40px tall with 0 16px padding, border-radius 16px, background #d8f4f609, backdrop-filter blur(25px), 2px solid #d6ebfd30 border, label "Get started" in Inter 14px weight 600 line-height 1.43 color #ffffff with 0px letter-spacing, and box-shadow 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). Pair it with a ghost button of identical size and radius, transparent background, 1px transparent border, label "Log in" in Inter 14px weight 600 color #a1a4a5, with a 16px gap between them.

2. Build a hero section on #000000 inside a 1280px container with 96px top padding. On the left, in a 480px column, place a pill badge (9999px radius, 1px #d6ebfd30 border, #d8f4f609 fill, 4px 8px padding, Inter 12px weight 400 #f0f0f0) and then, after 24px, an H1 in Domaine (fallback Newsreader) weight 400 at 96px, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing -0.96px, color #f0f0f0, with 12px bottom padding. Follow it with a paragraph in Inter 18px weight 400 line-height 1.5 color #a1a4a5, and then, after 32px, the primary and ghost button pair. On the right, place a 3D render of a matte-black cube. Behind everything, run a soft diagonal light streak image at full viewport width.

3. Build a bento feature card: background #d8f4f609, 1px solid #d6ebfd30 border, border-radius 24px, padding 24px. At the top, add a decorative radial highlight at the upper edge. Inside, place a live mockup: a 6px-radius badge reading "Delivered" in Inter 12px weight 500, capitalize, color #46fea5d4, on a 12% tint of the same green with 2px 6px padding. Below it, three log lines in Commit Mono 14px line-height 1.43, with "HTTP 200:" in #a0a0a0 and the ID strings in #6c6c6c. Finish with a title in ABC Favorit (fallback Geist) 20px weight 400 line-height 1.3 color #fcfdffef and a description in Inter 14px weight 400 color #a1a4a5, separated by 8px.

4. Build a navigation bar: position sticky, top 0, height 58px, transparent background over #000000, contents centered in a 1280px container. On the left, an 80px-wide wordmark in #f0f0f0. In the center, a row of items (Features, Company, Enterprise, Help, Docs, AI with 12px chevrons, plus Pricing) in Inter 14px weight 500 color #a1a4a5 with 4px 12px padding. On the right, a ghost "Log in" button and a glass "Get started" button, each 40px tall with 16px radius and 0 16px padding, 8px apart. Add no border or shadow to the bar.

## Monospace Majority

Commit Mono appears 559 times against Inter's 292, and #a0a0a0 code ink is the most-used text color at 219 instances. The discipline is that code is the page's primary content and illustration, not a supporting screenshot. Three things break it: replacing code windows with abstract feature icons, styling code as a rasterized image, or tinting syntax with a rainbow theme. The palette is four grays plus #ffff92 strings. Extend the system by adding new code-shaped artifacts (CLI output, JSON payloads, webhook bodies, DNS records) in Commit Mono 12px or 14px at weight 400 on #000000, inside 16px-radius hairline windows. When a new feature needs explaining, show its request and response before writing a sentence about it.

## Hairline Discipline

Every container on the page is drawn by the same 1px #d6ebfd30 line, a 19% cool white, on pure #000000. No container is drawn by a shadow, a gray panel or a gradient border. This is the thesis in structural form: a black void where light lines describe objects. The discipline breaks the moment a designer introduces a #1a1a1a card, a colored border, a 2px outline on a card, or a blurred drop shadow. Each of these adds a second depth language. Extend it by keeping new surfaces at #d8f4f609 or transparent, outlining them with the one hairline, and nesting radii downward from 24px to 16px, 10px, 6px and 4px. For emphasis, swap the border color to Sunbeam String #ffff92 on a single active element rather than thickening it.

## Serif Exception

Domaine appears exactly twice in the extracted data, the 96px hero H1 and its 76.8px responsive state. Every other heading is Favorit. The discipline is one serif moment per page, set at weight 400 with -0.96px tracking and line-height 1.0, so the first screen reads as editorial while everything below reads as engineering. It breaks if the serif spreads to section headings, pricing titles or card titles, where it would dilute the contrast it exists to create. Extend it by giving each top-level landing page its own single Domaine headline and nothing more. Keep Favorit 56px with -2.8px tracking as the workhorse for every section heading beneath it.

## Similar Brands

- **Resend** — shares Vercel's true-black canvas and monospace-forward product storytelling, but tracks its headlines tighter (-0.05em) and uses weight 400 where Vercel favors 600.
- **Resend** — shares Linear's translucent-white hairline borders and dark bento grids, but swaps Linear's purple accent glow for a near-zero chromatic budget.
- **Resend** — shares Raycast's rendered 3D hero objects lit on black, without Raycast's saturated red brand color.
- **Resend** — shares Supabase's developer audience, dark ground and green success semantics, but confines green to 12px status badges instead of using it as the brand CTA.
- **Resend** — competes with Postmark in transactional email, and inverts Postmark's light, color-led marketing into a black, code-led one.
